note: ART-005 / stage 3 T3.2: data-driven -ArtPreview board art. Zone palette and glyphs are keyed by zone KEY (never by board); lighting is one profile per board. Budget per profile: exactly 1 directional light with shadow + at most 6 point lights without shadows. Light sections are not gameplay zones: point lights sit at authored board-relative spots and a section (cells within half a light's radius) never coincides with one zone (tools/art/art_board_fixtures.py check: Jaccard < 0.5). Colors: zone 'color' is sRGB hex (FLinearColor(FColor) in code), light 'colorLinear' is linear RGB. Nothing here is artistically accepted.
renderNote: W4-A (2026-09-29, user decision DX12/SM6 + Lumen, High reference): every light profile declares units (points in candelas = the editor probe values, P17/ART-004 lights were CANDELAS; the pre-W4 packaged client spawned them Unitless, x1/625 = 9.3 EV darker - G01), a Movable SkyLight from /Game/S08/Render/TC_S08_AmbientDome that replaces the former point 'fill' ambient, the fixed exposure of the editor control scene (histogram min = max brightness 2^1.3 = 2.46229, bias 0, EV100 1.3) and a key CSM fitted to the diorama camera. Sky intensities are calibrated in the W4-A bench (docs/game-design/evidence/ART-004/render-dx12-lumen-2026-09-29.md); status stays 'предложено'.
contentNote: T4.2 (2026-09-29): every zone style names its MI_ART005_Zone_<Key> (child of the W4-B game-layer master /Game/UM/Materials/M_UM_GameLayer, LayerColor = FLinearColor::FromSRGBColor(color), the value the runtime tint used) and glyphMeshes names one SM_ART005_ZoneGlyph_<Glyph> per glyph (the S08GlyphPieces cubes merged, pivot on the glyph slot centre); built once through MCP in the live editor by tools/art/t42_zone_content.py, cooked through DirectoriesToAlwaysCook /Game/ArtTests/ART005. The client falls back to the runtime tint / cube pieces when an asset is missing (traced).
zoneEdgeOrder: zone i of a cell draws its stroke on side i: 0 near (+Y), 1 left (-X), 2 far (-Y), 3 right (+X); glyph slot i: 0 near-left, 1 far-right, 2 far-left, 3 near-right; a fifth zone reuses side/slot i % 4 (never dropped)
